text: Foreign anthropologist Cathy Kean comes to Bali to write a book on Leák, the strongest black magic, and with her lover Mahendra seeks out [the cackling Queen of the Leák|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. The Queen carves a spell into Cathy's thigh and meets her in the graveyard at midnight, until [Cathy's head tears free, trailing its organs|images|corpses and body parts], and flies off to [devour an unborn baby from its mother's womb|who_suffers|expectant parents]. Mahendra learns mantras from his uncle Machesse, who warns him that [Cathy is no longer the woman he loves|ending|victims become the evil].
